overview_description.description:
Medinas Health is a pre-owned medical equipment marketplace that helps to manage the sales process while saving time and money.

The company is a technology-driven asset management and remarketing solutions for hospitals. Medinas Health was founded in 2017 and is based in Berkeley, California.
